title: Nothing Great Is Imagined Alone

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Separate the attention-getting claim from the supporting explanation because viewers encounter a poster at different reading distances.
strategic_value: A large promise and small invitation can draw people into Figma’s collaboration story without requiring them to read everything at once.
demonstration: Large black uppercase text fills the upper yellow field; a smaller paragraph and campaign URL sit near the bottom.
practical_value: Set two reading levels: a short claim for scanning and a concrete reason to continue.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Stack the oversized campaign line at upper left across four tight lines.

content_islands.name: Supporting invitation
content_islands.spec: Place the smaller Einstein-related explanation and URL at lower left, separated by open space.

reference_purposes.Application: The portrait artwork separates a large campaign statement from smaller explanatory copy and URL.
reference_purposes.Intent: The printed supporting text invites a team to learn from a story of collaborative discovery.

ingredient.name: Two-level campaign typography
ingredient.role: Provide a quick claim and a slower explanation.
ingredient.application: Use a large compact headline, a broad pause and a smaller supporting paragraph with destination.
ingredient.scope: Observed portrait campaign layout; no numeric type sizes or universal spacing ratio are supplied.
